THE_PIONEER.headline: You want to set the direction of the relationship yourself.
THE_PIONEER.body:
You are skilled at drawing the big picture of the relationship. You have no aversion to leading your partner and presenting the path forward.

However, this initiative can sometimes overwhelm your partner. If you move forward without asking for their pace or opinion, they will feel like they are just 'following' rather than 'walking together'.

Your true strength is the power to open the way. When you use this power together with your partner, the relationship becomes richer.
patterns: You decide quickly and expect your partner to follow.
You are good at designing the big direction of the relationship.
You sometimes feel frustrated by your partner's slower pace.
THE_PIONEER.best_reason: Someone who quietly supports you and keeps you centered when you waver.
THE_PIONEER.challenging_reason: If both want to lead, it can turn into a power struggle.
actions: Before an important decision, ask yourself, 'Am I asking my partner's pace?'
This week, ask what your partner wants to do first.
Share your direction verbally and wait for their reaction.
red_flags: Check if you only see your partner as 'part of my plan'.
Are you taking it for granted that they are accommodating you?

THE_ADAPTER.headline: You smoothly lead the relationship by adapting to your partner.
THE_ADAPTER.body:
You are good at going with the flow of the relationship. You have an excellent ability to read your partner's emotions and melt away conflict in advance.

However, if this flexibility is excessive, your own feelings disappear. If you keep putting off saying 'I want this', your disappointment might explode at some point.

Your partner thinks you are always fine. So they have no chance to know your true feelings. Sometimes you need to reveal your discomfort to keep the relationship healthy.
patterns: You prioritize reading your partner's mood and react to it.
You yield your opinions to avoid conflict.
You hold onto disappointment for a long time and explode all at once.
THE_ADAPTER.best_reason: Someone with honesty and stability will bring out your true feelings.
THE_ADAPTER.challenging_reason: If both only accommodate, real conflict will never surface.
actions: Once a day, speak your preference first.
If you feel disappointed, say it within 24 hours.
Express 'I like this right now' often to your partner.
red_flags: Are you putting off your feelings thinking 'I'll just adjust'?
Does your partner not know your preferences at all?

THE_RADIATOR.headline: You have a passionate romance with clear expression.
THE_RADIATOR.body:
You can't hide your love. Your emotions show on your face, and you pour all your energy into expressing them to the person you like.

This heat makes your partner bright, but your mood swings can be misunderstood. Your explosive power when angry is just as big.

The key is the direction of your passion. If you pour your hot energy only into your partner, it won't last. You need to create space to cool your heat with time alone.
patterns: You fall in love fast and cool down fast.
You repeat the cycle of idealizing your partner and being disappointed.
You can't hide your emotions but may not consider your partner's pace.
THE_RADIATOR.best_reason: Someone with a quiet and stable nature will contain your heat.
THE_RADIATOR.challenging_reason: Two same fires can burn each other out.
actions: Even if angry, wait a day before speaking.
Observe your partner's way of expressing love. It might differ from yours.
Intentionally secure time alone.
red_flags: Check if you are overly dependent on your partner.
Look back to see if you said hurtful words when you exploded.

THE_KEEPER.headline: You dedicate yourself deeply to one person.
THE_KEEPER.body:
You don't open your heart easily. You choose people carefully, and once you give your heart, you try to take responsibility to the end.

This dedication builds deep trust, but if your partner takes it for granted, disappointment builds. Also, if your focus is too intense, your partner may feel suffocated.

Your love is quiet but strong. You need the wisdom to step back sometimes so your partner can handle its intensity.
patterns: You focus all your energy on one person.
You sensitively notice small changes in your partner.
You tend to put your own needs behind your partner's.
THE_KEEPER.best_reason: Someone who warmly receives and returns your dedication.
THE_KEEPER.challenging_reason: With someone who hides their feelings, your dedication can feel lonely.
actions: Once a month, directly request what you want to receive.
Don't solve your partner's problems for them; watch them instead.
Share your emotions with your partner too.
red_flags: Are you accommodating your partner excessively?
Is your dedication making your partner helpless?

THE_ANCHOR.headline: You are a stable and reliable partner.
THE_ANCHOR.body:
You provide an unwavering center in the relationship. You give dependability rather than fluttering excitement, and you are someone your partner can lean on.

However, stability is sometimes read as boredom. Your partner might appreciate your reliability but look for 'excitement' elsewhere.

Your strength is continuity. If you add small events and changes on top of it, the relationship will have both stability and excitement.
patterns: You show love through actions rather than emotional expression.
When conflict arises, you tend to take time in silence.
You may notice your partner's emotional changes late.
THE_ANCHOR.best_reason: Someone expressive adds excitement on top of your stability.
THE_ANCHOR.challenging_reason: If both are passive to change, the relationship can stagnate.
actions: Once a month, plan a small event your partner will like.
Once a day, express your emotions in words.
Pay attention to your partner's emotional changes.
red_flags: Are you stopping your efforts thinking 'this is enough'?
Are you failing to notice your partner's changes?

THE_CULTIVATOR.headline: You have a romance where you carefully care for your partner.
THE_CULTIVATOR.body:
You read your partner's needs sensitively. You have deep consideration and are skilled at creating an environment where your partner feels comfortable.

However, if this care is excessive, your partner becomes helpless. The attitude of 'I'll do everything for you' can take away their chance to grow.

Your love is like gardening. Giving only water and light so the plant grows on its own lasts longer than making it grow.
patterns: You take care of your partner before they need it.
You try to solve your partner's problems for them.
You feel disappointed when your partner lacks gratitude.
THE_CULTIVATOR.best_reason: You understand each other's way of caring and feel comfortable in it.
THE_CULTIVATOR.challenging_reason: With someone with flashy expressions, your quiet dedication might not be seen well.
actions: Even if your partner fails, don't intervene once; watch.
Practice providing your care only when requested.
Secure time for yourself.
red_flags: Are you blocking your partner's independence with over-care?
Is your partner taking your dedication for granted?

THE_BLADE.headline: You have an honest and straightforward romance.
THE_BLADE.body:
You hate lies. You prefer clear emotions over ambiguous relationships or superficial expressions.

This straightforwardness gives trust, but sometimes it hurts your partner's feelings. Even the right words become wounds if the timing and method are wrong.

Your true strength is 'saying exactly what is needed when your partner needs it'. If you wrap this power with warmth, the relationship becomes much deeper.
patterns: You point out problems and try to solve them right away.
You can't stand ambiguity.
You lead conversations with logic rather than emotion.
THE_BLADE.best_reason: Someone who softly wraps your honesty and reads the emotions you miss.
THE_BLADE.challenging_reason: If both push strongly, conversation turns into a fight.
actions: Before pointing out, ask for your partner's perspective first.
Ask a question before giving an answer.
Try expressing your emotions in words too.
red_flags: Are you pushing your partner because you are right?
Is your directness felt as a threat to your partner?

THE_GEM.headline: You have high ideals and a fastidious romance.
THE_GEM.body:
You don't compromise easily. You carefully observe your partner's taste, way of speaking, and attitude one by one.

This meticulousness raises the quality of the relationship, but it can be a burden to your partner. If they feel 'why am I always lacking?', love becomes heavy.

Your standards are a gift. But when you don't force them on your partner, the relationship grows into something for both of you.
patterns: You remember your partner's minor flaws for a long time.
You miss the timing waiting for the perfect moment.
You frequently check the perfection of the relationship.
THE_GEM.best_reason: Someone with depth and patience receives your standards without burden.
THE_GEM.challenging_reason: If both seek perfection, nothing will ever be enough.
actions: If you are 80% satisfied, say 'it's enough'.
Acknowledge and let go of one of your partner's flaws each week.
Be generous to yourself too.
red_flags: Can you not say 'this is enough'?
Is your partner nervous around you?

THE_DEEP.headline: You have a deep and cautious romance.
THE_DEEP.body:
You don't reveal your emotions easily. You observe your partner enough and dig deep once you make up your mind.

This cautiousness looks like mature love, but it's hard for your partner to know your true feelings. The question 'does this person like me?' pushes the relationship away.

Your love is like the ocean. The surface is calm, but you need to come up to the surface sometimes and let your partner know 'I am here'.
patterns: You express after analyzing and organizing your emotions.
You observe your partner for a long time and approach slowly.
You reveal your true feelings late, frustrating your partner.
THE_DEEP.best_reason: Someone who understands depth waits for your slow love.
THE_DEEP.challenging_reason: With someone who wants fast emotional expression, the pace might not match.
actions: Don't analyze your feelings; just say them.
Express your heart in one sentence once a day.
Make your partner understand your pace.
red_flags: Are you missing the timing while analyzing?
Are you giving your partner a chance to know your heart?

THE_SPRING.headline: You have a quiet and affectionate romance.
THE_SPRING.body:
You have the power to make your partner comfortable. Without exaggeration, you naturally seep into their day.

However, if this quietness is excessive, your partner will find it hard to know your feelings. The question 'does this person like me?' delays the relationship.

Your affection is strong. But when you express that affection in clear words once in a while, the relationship deepens.
patterns: You convey love through atmosphere rather than words.
You adapt well to your partner's mood.
Your emotional expression is late, and you might miss opportunities.
THE_SPRING.best_reason: Someone clear pulls out your quiet heart.
THE_SPRING.challenging_reason: If both are quiet, feelings might never be revealed.
actions: Say directly that you like them.
Express how you feel about your partner once a week.
Tell your partner your pace.
red_flags: Are you putting it off thinking 'they will know someday'?
Is your partner doubting your feelings?
